title: Recover an I2C bus with SDA held low
description: An I2C transaction sometimes stalls after a sensor reset. A logic analyzer shows SDA low while SCL is high. Plan a diagnosis and a bounded recovery policy. Include pull-ups, bus ownership, target documentation, and escalation when recovery fails.
prompt: An I2C transaction sometimes stalls after a sensor reset. A logic analyzer shows SDA low while SCL is high. Plan a diagnosis and a bounded recovery policy. Include pull-ups, bus ownership, target documentation, and escalation when recovery fails.
constraints: State assumptions and separate measurements from guarantees.
rubric: Distinguish a controller state issue from an external device holding the line.
Inspect electrical levels, pull-ups, and reset/power sequencing.
Use documented recovery with timeouts; do not drive against a device holding a line.
follow_ups: How would multiple bus controllers affect recovery?
What information should the driver report after a timeout?
hints: Write down the boundary cases before choosing an implementation.
Use explicit integer widths and keep intermediate values in range.
